summary: this-call delegation thunk. Forwards the receiver pointer unchanged to DestructorWithResourceCleanup(this) and returns that function's int result; the thunk itself performs no field access or other work.

operations.description: Delegate the receiver this to DestructorWithResourceCleanup, passing this unchanged.
Return the delegated function's int result directly; the thunk adds no computation of its own.

unresolved: DestructorWithResourceCleanup is named only in the raw source text and has no callee evidence entry, so its address, resource-cleanup semantics, and whether the cleanup is conditional are not in evidence here.
No caller or vtable slot is recorded, so the owner class and the init/cleanup lifecycle this thunk participates in are unknown.
The ABI name VTable_Init_Conditional_Resource_Free is a LEGACY label; it is not independent evidence of an owner or of conditional behavior.
